citations.assessment: The witness names Adda Mari, Rav Naḥman bar Barukh, Rav Ashi bar Avin and Rav Yehudah, in an explanation of the red-madder ties.

The witness has Neḥemyah bar Barukh and Rav Ḥiyya bar Avin in a separate discussion of disciplinary pursuit. The two transmission sequences differ; the different subjects matter to deciding whether either is corrupt.

holds.reason: Both printed reports are attested. Heilprin’s error judgment is retained as an attributed inference; neither transmission is rewritten.
